description: Rodinia 3.1 Needleman-Wunsch: two seed-7 sequences, BLOSUM62 scores, tiled DP wavefront and complete measured-matrix verification.

scaling_param.name: sequence_length
scaling_param.description: Requested sequence length N, rounded up to a multiple of block_size; DP matrix includes one border row and column.

non_scaling_params.name: block_size
non_scaling_params.description: Block size (threads per block for wavefront processing)

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Cold-cache calibration: when true, a vector-add warmer boosts the GPU clock and evicts the last-level cache before each timed iteration, so the kernel is measured cold-cache at a boosted clock (matching a cold-cache simulator). Set false for legacy warm-cache measurement.
